# First 5 California

> > First 5 California provides evidence-based resources, activities, and guidance for parents and caregivers supporting child development from birth through age 5.

The site offers comprehensive support for early childhood development through the Stronger Starts Program, featuring bilingual content in English and Spanish. Resources include developmental milestone tracking, play-based learning activities, parenting guidance, and information about California's ScholarShare 529 college savings program and student aid resources.

## Key Topics

- Child Development (0-5 years)
- Brain Development
- Motor Skills (Fine & Gross)
- Early Literacy & Reading
- Infant Sleep & Self-Soothing
- Parent-Child Bonding
- Language Development
- Early Math Skills
- Social-Emotional Development
- Sensory Play & Exploration
- Special Needs Support
- Stronger Starts Program
- ScholarShare 529 College Savings
- Bilingual Resources (English/Spanish)
- Play-Based Learning

## Developmental Milestones & Topics

- [Baby Milestones from 4 to 11 Months Old](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/topics/baby-milestones): Baby development milestones guide for 4-11 months: motor & language skills
- [Preschooler Motor Development - Activities and Resources](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/topics/preschooler-motor-development): Preschooler fine & gross motor skills development resources & activities
- [Newborn Reading- Books for Newborn](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/topics/newborn-reading): Newborn reading resources & book recommendations for early literacy
- [Disciplina del bebé](https://www.first5california.com/es-mx/topics/baby-discipline): Spanish: Baby discipline & positive parenting guidance for caregivers
- [Desarrollo social y emocional de tu bebé](https://www.first5california.com/es-mx/topics/baby-social-and-emotional-development): Spanish: Baby social-emotional development & resilience resources

## Play-Based Learning Activities

- [How to Embrace the Power of Play for Children With Special Needs](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/activities/how-to-embrace-the-power-of-play-for-children-with-special-needs): Adaptive play activities & sensory games for children with special needs
- [Brain-Boosting Games for Your Baby](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/activities/brain-boosting-games-for-your-baby): Early learning games for baby brain development & sensory exploration
- [Making Math Fun: 5 Activities for You and Your Child](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/activities/making-math-fun-5-activities-for-you-and-your-child): 5 early math activities & games for toddlers and preschoolers
- [Take a Silly Break: 7 Giggle-Inspiring Activities](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/activities/take-a-silly-break-7-giggle-inspiring-activities): 7 silly play activities for motor skills & parent-child bonding
- [Match It Up](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/activities/match-it-up-preschooler): DIY memory matching game for preschoolers: early math & brain development
- [Name Art](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/activities/name-art): Preschool name recognition activity for early literacy & writing skills
- [Toy Parade](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/activities/toy-parade): Indoor pretend play activity for toddlers and preschoolers
- [Peek-a-Boo](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/activities/peek-a-boo-baby): Peek-a-boo activity for infant brain & social-emotional development

## Sleep & Rest Guidance

- [Importance of Rest Time for Kids & Babies: Naps & Sleep Guide](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/articles/importance-of-rest-time): Guide on naps, sleep patterns & rest time for infant-preschooler development
- [Getting Through the Night: The Importance of Teaching Your Child How to Self-Soothe](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/articles/getting-through-the-night-the-importance-of-teaching-your-child-how-to-self): Self-soothing techniques for infant sleep training & bedtime routines

## Actividades en Español

- [Juego sensorial](https://www.first5california.com/es-mx/activities/sensory-play-baby): Spanish: Sensory play activity for baby brain & motor skill development
- [El juego de la memoria](https://www.first5california.com/es-mx/activities/match-it-up-preschooler): Spanish: Memory matching game for preschool brain & math development
- [Desfile de juguetes](https://www.first5california.com/es-mx/activities/toy-parade): Spanish: Toy parade imaginative play activity for preschoolers

## Family Resources & Services

- [Saving for Higher Education - Student Aid and Scholarships](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/services/saving-for-higher-education): California 529 college savings, scholarships & student aid resources
- [4 Summer Safety Tips for Outdoor Adventures](https://www.first5california.com/en-us/articles/4-summer-safety-tips-for-outdoor-adventures): Summer safety tips: sun protection & playground safety for young children
